# RikiSTM — AI/ML Engineer

> 10 years QA engineer transitioning to AI/ML. Focus: AI reliability,
> MLOps, NLP, bias mitigation, explainable AI, Model Evaluation.

## Projects
- [Telco Churn MLOps](https://rikistm.github.io/telco-churn-mlops-pipeline/): End-to-end MLOps pipeline with MLflow, FastAPI, XAI, and Bias/Fairness testing.

- [ML Algorithms from Scratch](https://rikistm.github.io/numpy-ml-from-scratch/): NumPy-only implementations of core ML algorithms (Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees).

- [Banking77 Intent Router](https://github.com/RikiSTM/banking77-intent-router/): End-to-end NLP baseline exploring class imbalance, lexical overlap (Jaccard), and business-driven intent taxonomy refinement.

- [Neural Network from Scratch](https://github.com/RikiSTM/neural-network-from-scratch/): Core Deep Learning engine (MLP, Backpropagation, Computational Graphs) built from scratch using pure NumPy to demystify tensor math and the "black box".
